# Codabar (EN 798)

[Codabar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Codabar) is a symbology whose input consists of up to 60 characters, prefixed and suffixed with letters `A` to `D`, and can containing any of the following characters in between:

* Digits (`0`-`9`)
* Hyphen (`-`)
* Period (`.`)
* Dollar sign (`$`)
* Forward slash (`/`)
* Plus sign (`+`)
* Colon (`:`)

The standard Code 39 symbol can rendered by using the `CODABAR` symbology type.

:::tip Note
* A check digit is not generated by default, but a module-16 one can be added by setting `checkDigit` to `1`.
* The aforementioned check digit can be rendered in the human-readable text by setting `checkDigit` to `2`.
:::

## Example

![Codabar](/assets/barcodes/one-dimensional/codabar.svg)

```ts
createStream({
  symbology: SymbologyType.CODABAR
}, 'A12345:67890B')
```
